_comment: Hand-written bookkeeping for docs/FORK.md. scripts/fork-pr-table.sh merges this with the live GitHub API data; the rendered tables live between the markers in docs/FORK.md. Every open PR that is missing a note here gets a loud TODO row, so nothing is ever silently omitted.
author: abencq

features.title: Latent saving, decoding and branching
features.alt: The latent sidecar and the two things it makes possible

features.title: Linux DLSS: x3–x6, with native Frame Generation

front_claim_sentence: Everything general enough is submitted upstream, which means

2441.note: Save, decode and branch latents for Wan, LongCat, LTX-2, MiniMax H3 and Magi Human; pick a latent file straight from a video

2292.note: A default output filename for every model, with a template checked before the generation starts

2290.short: the keywords, the format specs, the precheck
2290.note: Effective-output keywords and Python format specs for the Output Filename box

2535.note: DLSS temporal upscaling at x3-x4, up to x6 on RTX 50, with the native Linux Frame Generation worker and installer

2295.note: Native Linux DLSS Frame Generation worker, temporal-only x2-x4 (x5/x6 on RTX 50)

2284.note: SpargeAttn install on Linux with CUDA 13 for RTX 30XX-50XX

2286.note: scripts/install-flashattn.sh, a Linux builder for flash-attn 2.8.3.post1 on RTX 50xx (Blackwell)

2289.note: Optional Sol-Attn sparse self-attention for native LTX-2 inference (experimental)

2551.note: Keep LTX-2 on CUDA Graph and stop the minutes-long first steps of PyTorch compilation; the Inductor cache of a session is kept and its shapes capped. The copy in this fork carries the measured RTX 5090 timings in docs/MODELS.md; its code lines are identical

2553.note: Prompt enhancer crash with Auto Speculative Decoding on GGUF

2568.note: Time stamps at the start of the console lines WanGP prints, on the lines the terminal draws only

2288.note: Sliding Window sizes up to 999 frames for every video model

2482.note: Crash when saving audio that came out empty

2478.note: “Continue Video” audio joins when the soundtrack ends early

2526.note: Shell prompt left dead after Ctrl+C in a WanGP run

2565.note: SyntaxWarning printed at startup by the About tab credits line

closed_reason.2286: not picked up; the builder script stays in this fork
closed_reason.2565: the fix is upstream's own: the 3D update of 2026-11-03 rewrote that credits line with the escape

fork_only.note: Watchdog that turns a silent torch Inductor compile-sidecar stall into a reported error (shared/utils/compile_watchdog.py, started from wgp.py). Not submitted yet: it must become opt-in, its 600 s stall rule needs an activity-aware check so a slow but healthy compile is never killed, and the design note shared/inductor-quiesce-refork-deadlock.md cited by its docstring still has to be written
Local fixes around the DLSS entries: the Frame Generation multipliers offered on a multi-GPU host, and a saved Frame Generation choice that the menus used to reset (part of #2535)

fork_infra: git publish-main, which publishes the integration branch as the fork default branch
scripts/fork-pr-table.sh, which regenerates the tables of this page from the GitHub API
the fork banner at the top of README.md and this file, which state the modifications for section 4.1 of the WanGP Community License
